messages:
Maria (eng-platform): Quick heads-up — product requested a dashboard that shows KV and prefix-cache "warmth"/reuse across workloads. They want hit rate, evictions, reuse-by-workload, and the tail latency split by cache hit vs miss. Can runtime/infra weigh in on what we can realistically emit without exploding cardinality?

Devon (eng-runtime): We can emit: redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total. Also a histogram for cache lookup latency. But labels matter — per-tenant+model+workload will be high-cardinality.

Sam (eng-infra): Agreed on cardinality. Propose we only label by workload (low-cardinality tag we already have) + model_family, and add optional exemplar tagging for tenant when sampled. We can also roll up to region.

Alex (eng-ml): From ML side, reuse-by-workload needs sequence-length bucketing — short vs long prefixes have very different reuse. Suggest adding label seq_len_bin={short,medium,long}. That keeps 3x cardinality instead of raw length.

Jess (product): Important for PMs: we need to slice by rollout groups (canary vs stable) and model version. If those aren't labels we'll lose rollout observability. Can we keep model_version but avoid tenant-level?

Devon (eng-runtime): model_version ok but limit to major.minor (e.g., v1.4) to avoid too many values. For rollout groups, we can emit a low-cardinality route_tag label that the router sets.

Maria (eng-platform): Nice. Can you propose exact metric names + PromQL for panels? Product wants 1) global hit rate, 2) per-workload reuse heatmap, 3) evictions trend, 4) latency by hit/miss.

Devon (eng-runtime): Draft names & example queries: 
- Metric names: redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total, redwood_kv_lookup_duration_seconds_bucket
- Global hit rate: 
  sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / (sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) + sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_misses_total[5m])))
- Per-workload reuse (heatmap): use a metric redwood_kv_reuse_count{workload,seq_len_bin} and render as heatmap. If we can't add a reuse_count, we can approximate by "requests where prefix_kv_hit_count>0"
- Evictions trend: 
  sum(rate(redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total[1h])) by (region,workload)
- Latency split: 
  histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_kv_lookup_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,cache_hit))

Sam (eng-infra): Two infra notes: 1) add cluster-side aggregation to avoid cardinality blow-up in remote write. 2) store series with metric relabeling to keep only allowed label sets.

Alex (eng-ml): For reuse-by-workload we should emit both "reuse_count" and "reuse_unique_prefixes" so we can tell if one workload reuses few prefixes a lot vs many prefixes a bit.

Jess (product): Also want a cost panel: estimated tokens saved = hit_count * avg_prefix_tokens. Can we surface token-weighted hits?

Devon (eng-runtime): We can emit redwood_kv_token_savings_total (cumulative tokens avoided due to cache hits) computed at runtime. It requires runtime to increment by tokens_skipped_on_hit per response. Slightly heavier but doable.

Maria (eng-platform): Nice edge-case: when fallback occurs to smaller model don't we want metrics to indicate fallback due to miss? E.g., route_tag=fallback.

Sam (eng-infra): Yes — router sets route_tag. We'll include route_tag in metrics but keep it low-cardinality (stable,canary,fallback).

Alex (eng-ml): About instrumentation: please avoid tenant_id label. If debugging, we can add a sampled debug counter that includes tenant_id and request_id in logs only when sample flag is set.

Maria (eng-platform): OK action list: 
- Devon: implement metric names above + seq_len_bin label + token_savings counter (owner: Devon) — target: 2 weeks (1800000s).
- Sam: add aggregation + relabel config for remote write, ensure route_tag propagated (owner: Sam) — target: 1 week.
- Alex: emit reuse_unique_prefixes and advise on seq_len buckets (owner: Alex) — target: 2 weeks.
- Product: Jess to mock dashboard panels and thresholds (owner: Jess) — target: 4 days.

Jess (product): I'll prototype a Grafana board with these panels and ping design for UX copy.

Devon (eng-runtime): Quick note on storage: reuse_unique_prefixes is cardinality-y if we tag with too many dimensions. We'll emit at workload+model_family only.

ops-bot: Reminder — create an RFC for metric additions if >3 new metrics.

Maria (eng-platform): Good call. I'll draft an RFC summarizing metric schema, label cardinality limits, and the dashboard wireframe. Will link here when ready.

Sam (eng-infra): One last ops ask: add alerts for sudden drop in hit rate (>20% drop in 5m) and large spike in evictions (x5 baseline). We should define baselines per-workload.

Maria (eng-platform): Added to the RFC TODOs. Thanks all — moving this to tracking board. If any constraints pop up, call them out in the RFC thread. :thumbsup:
